speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To understand the cause of your acute diarrhea, how many loose stools have you had in the last 24 hours, and have there been any blood or mucus in them?

speaker: Patient
text: 58-year-old female. The patient has been treated for community-acquired pneumonia with levofloxacin on the medical floor. She reports developing watery diarrhea with at least 9 episodes within the last two days, accompanied by lower abdominal discomfort and cramping.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Antibiotic-associated diarrhea (likely *Clostridioides difficile* infection).

I have already noted your recent treatment with levofloxacin for pneumonia and the onset of watery diarrhea with cramping. Before confirming the diagnosis, please tell me if you have experienced any fever or recent hospitalization in the past two months, as these increase the risk of *C. diff*. I will also order a stool test for *C. difficile* toxins.
